title: What Happens If You Swallow Gum

sections.name: What Happens If You Swallow Gum
lines: You've probably heard that swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years.
Gum is made to resist breaking down, so your stomach can't digest it like food.
But your gut doesn't need to digest it to move it. Muscles squeeze it along with everything else.
And within a few days, it comes out the other end.
The only problem is swallowing lots of it, all the time. Doctors have found gum blockages in kids who did.
So one piece, by accident? Totally fine.
